# Link click attribution and stats

> Every redirect on a share link fires a click event to Kafka, a projector stores it in `ClickHouse`, and the owner reads a 7-day per-minute click count from `GET /links/:code/stats`.

_Part of [domain/marketing](../../units/domain/marketing.md)_

When someone opens `GET /l/:code`, the controller's `redirect` resolves the link first. If the request header `x-edge-click-recorded` is not `1` (meaning the edge worker has not already counted it), it calls `recordClick`. That builds a `link.clicked` event with a fresh [`uuidv7`](../../../../packages/backend/scripts/load-tests/lib/utils.js#L14) click id, the code, a timestamp, the country (from the `cf-ipcountry` header), the referer cut to 300 characters, and a flag for whether it came via the edge. It sends the event to Kafka (topic `links.events`, keyed by code) without waiting, so the redirect is never slowed down, and a failed send is silently dropped. The redirect then adds `ref=<code>` to the destination so checkout can attribute the sale. For how links are created and resolved, see [Creating and resolving share links](share-short-links.md). On the other side, [`LinkClicksProjector`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/infra/link-clicks.projector.ts#L10) (name `link-clicks`) listens to the links topic. It keeps only events that match [`LinkClicked`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts#L17), reshapes each one into a row (`click_id`, `code`, `ts` without the trailing `Z`, `country`, `referer`, `via_edge` as 0 or 1) and bulk-inserts into the `ClickHouse` `link_clicks` table through [`ClickHouseSink`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/infrastructure/projections/sinks/clickhouse.sink.ts#L10). Duplicates are not removed on insert. The code comment says they are deduped by click id at merge time. The owner reads the numbers with `GET /links/:code/stats`. `stats` checks the link exists and belongs to the caller (otherwise 404), then queries `link_clicks_minute` for the last 7 days, summing clicks per minute.

**Look at:** [`LinkClicked` in share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts#L17) · [share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts) · [share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts) · [`LinkClicksProjector` in link-clicks.projector.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/infra/link-clicks.projector.ts#L10) · [share-links.controller.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/api/share-links.controller.ts)

## Pieces

- [The link.clicked event and its payload](link-clicked-event.md): A versioned event (`defineEvent('link.clicked', 'links', 1, ...)`) carrying click id, code, time, country, referer and via-edge flag, with empty or false defaults.
- [Recording a click without slowing the redirect](fire-and-forget-click-recording.md): `recordClick` sends the Kafka message without awaiting it and swallows errors, and the controller skips it when the edge already recorded the click.
- Projector that copies click events into ClickHouse: [`LinkClicksProjector`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/infra/link-clicks.projector.ts#L10) turns `link.clicked` events into `link_clicks` rows and inserts them in batches.
- [Owner-only click stats for the last 7 days](link-stats-endpoint.md): `stats` checks ownership and returns per-minute click sums from `link_clicks_minute`.

## Also relies on

- [Creating and resolving share links](share-short-links.md): Links are created and resolved there; clicks are recorded during that redirect.

## Watch out

- Click sending is fire-and-forget: if Kafka is down, the click is lost without any error or retry.
- If the request carries `x-edge-click-recorded: 1`, the origin skips recording so clicks are not counted twice. Duplicate clicks still go into `link_clicks`, and deduping by click id happens later at merge time.
- `stats` reads `link_clicks_minute`, not `link_clicks`. The source does not show how that table is filled.
- `stats` returns 404 both for an unknown code and for a link owned by someone else, and it only covers the last 7 days.
